sloka: न तात मन्त्रे तव निश्चयोऽस्ति ।बालस्त्वमद्याप्यविपक्वबुद्धिः ।तस्मात्त्वयाप्यात्मविनाशनाय ।वचोऽर्थ्हीनम् बहु विप्रलप्तम् ॥६-१५-९॥।।
transliteration: na tāta mantre tava niścayo'sti ।bālastvamadyāpyavipakvabuddhiḥ ।tasmāttvayāpyātmavināśanāya ।vaco'rthhīnam bahu vipralaptam ॥6-15-9॥।।

translations.english: "O dear You have no capacity for decision making. You are young and not mature. Therefore, you are talking incoherently without any sense which is selfdestructive."
